text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No. BD/LG/LND/2/9/4. Land Ministry No. 4-3/8/2016/PC/205. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for BD/Millabadda Vidyalaya and will be acquired under the Provisions of the Act. Description of the land to be acquired: Lot No. 1 - Hopton Estate - Extent: 0.4535 Hectares. North: Part of Millabadda (Hopton Estate Claimed by Land Reform Commission Road Hopton Estate Claimed by M. Yoganathan); East: Part of Millabadda (M. Yoganathan and D. M. Karunarathna Claimed Hopton Estate; South: Part of Millabadda (Hopton Estate Claimed

by M. Yoganathan and D. M. Karunarathna Lot No. 11.1 and Lot No. 2 of M.P.B. 686); West: Lot No. 11.1 of 0.686 Council 2 Lot No. 2 of M.P. 2031 and part 2 of Millabadda (Hopton Estate Claimed by Land Reforms Commission). All persons interested in the aforesaid land is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Lunugala Divisional Secretariat on the 25th day of March 2024 at 9.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 11th day of March 2024, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Nirosha Chandhani Hennayake, Divisional Secretary, Lunugala. Divisional Secretariat Lunugala. 22nd January, 2024. EOG 01 - 0210
